Panels: A (blot, plot), B (micrograph), C (blot), D (blot).

Panel B: Immunoelectron microscopy of cerebellar cortex, four sub-images with scale bars visible: upper-left "2 μm", upper-right "0.5 μm", lower-left "0.5 μm", lower-right "0.1 μm". Caption text: "Immunoelectron microscopy of the cerebellar cortex of control mice, with staining using an anti‐HMGB1 antibody. Nucleus‐dominant distribution of the gold–silver complex particles was found (arrows in the upper left panel), although the particles were also found in the cytoplasm. In the cytoplasm (lower left panel), the mitochondrial membrane (arrow) and matrix (arrowhead) were stained. Higher‐magnification images of the mitochondrial matrix staining are shown in the upper and lower right panels." No explicit scale bar length stated in caption text itself, only on the image.

Panels: A (blot, plot), B (micrograph), C (blot), D (blot).

Panel A contains bar graphs (lower graphs) for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions showing mean ± SD band intensity quantification across WT, Atxn1-KI, and Atxn1-KI;HMGB1 genotypes (N=4 per group per caption). No individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bar graphs; only bars with error bars are shown.
Panels B, C, D are micrograph/blot only, not plots of averages.

Panels: A (blot, plot), B (micrograph), C (blot), D (blot).

Panel A bar graphs show error bars. Caption text: "The band intensity was quantified and is shown in the lower graphs. The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test." This defines error bars as SD (standard deviation).
Panels B, C, D are not plots (micrograph/blot only).
